name: SIS 05 — Transcript Request, Generation and Delivery — Drive Resolution Stabilized

parameters.content:
Workflow 05 — Transcript Request, Generation and Delivery

Creates an authorized, idempotent transcript request; retrieves one complete academic data model; renders a Google Docs transcript; exports and stores a PDF in Google Drive; records the document; and queues approved-recipient delivery through Workflow 08.

Credentials:
• Google Drive account
• SIS Supabase Service Role

Environment:
• SIS_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_URL
• SIS_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
• SIS_TRANSCRIPT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID (optional; blank uses My Drive root)
• WEBHOOK_URL (optional verification link)

No Gmail is sent directly here. The durable outbox event is dispatched by the active Workflow 08.

nodes.name: Workflow 05 Documentation
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Documents the complete Workflow 05 contract.
Input: none
Output: operator guidance
Error behaviour: none

nodes.name: Transcript Request Webhook
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Receives an authenticated staff or student transcript request from the staff portal.
Input: Bearer token plus student_id, institution_id, campus_id, recipient_email, purpose and idempotency_key.
Output: Raw webhook request.
Error behaviour: Unsupported methods are rejected by n8n; payload and authentication are validated downstream.

nodes.name: Normalize Transcript Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes the request and generates correlation/idempotency values without exposing secrets.
Input: Raw webhook body and headers.
Output: Validated request context.
Error behaviour: Permanent validation failures route to a sanitized HTTP 400 response.

nodes.name: Request Envelope Valid?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes valid request envelopes.
Input: Normalized request.
Output: Valid or invalid branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success:false, operation:'transcript.request.create', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, idempotency_key:$json.idempotency_key, error:{ code:$json.validation_error.code, message:$json.validation_error.message, retryable:false } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns the standard sanitized validation failure.
Input: Invalid normalized request.
Output: HTTP 400 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Validate Supabase User
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Validates the caller's Supabase Auth access token.
Input: Bearer token from the normalized request.
Output: Supabase user response.
Error behaviour: Temporary transport failures retry twice; invalid tokens are not retried as business operations.

nodes.name: Classify Supabase User
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies token validation without returning provider details.
Input: Supabase Auth response.
Output: Authenticated request context.
Error behaviour: Invalid tokens route to HTTP 401.

nodes.name: User Authenticated?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes authenticated users.
Input: Classified auth context.
Output: Authenticated or unauthorized branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success:false, operation:'transcript.request.create', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, idempotency_key:$json.idempotency_key, error:{ code:'AUTH_LOGIN_REQUIRED', message:'A valid staff or student login is required.', retryable:false } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Unauthorized
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns a sanitized authentication failure.
Input: Unauthenticated request.
Output: HTTP 401 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_request: { operation:'transcript.request.create', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, idempotency_key:$json.idempotency_key, institution_id:$json.institution_id, campus_id:$json.campus_id, requester:{ type:'authenticated_user', auth_user_id:$json.auth_user_id }, submitted_at:$json.submitted_at, source:{ channel:'staff_portal', source_submission_id:$json.idempotency_key }, payload:{ student_id:$json.student_id, recipient_email:$json.recipient_email, purpose:$json.purpose } } } }}

nodes.name: Create Transcript Request RPC
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Creates or reuses the authorized transcript request through the caller JWT.
Input: Authenticated request context.
Output: Stable RPC response.
Error behaviour: Transport failures retry twice; permanent database/business failures are classified downstream.

nodes.name: Classify Transcript Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies the request RPC and preserves its stable data.
Input: RPC transport/body.
Output: Request data or sanitized error.
Error behaviour: No retry; RPC and HTTP nodes own retries.

nodes.name: Transcript Request Created?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes successful request creation.
Input: Classified RPC.
Output: Success or business-failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Respond Transcript Business Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns the stable business failure.
Input: Failed request/model context.
Output: Sanitized JSON response.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Reusable Document Exists?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Avoids regenerating an existing PDF for an idempotent request.
Input: Successful request data.
Output: Reuse or generation branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Build Reused Document Response
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Builds the idempotent existing-document response.
Input: Existing request/document metadata.
Output: Standard success object.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Respond Transcript Success
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns the complete transcript outcome.
Input: Generated or reused standard success object.
Output: HTTP 200 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_request:{ operation:'transcript.model.get', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, institution_id:$json.institution_id, campus_id:$json.campus_id, requester:{type:'authenticated_user',auth_user_id:$json.auth_user_id}, source:{channel:'staff_portal'}, payload:{transcript_request_id:$json.request_data.transcript_request_id} } } }}

nodes.name: Get Transcript Model RPC
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Retrieves the complete transcript data model under the caller JWT.
Input: Authorized transcript request ID.
Output: Stable transcript model RPC response.
Error behaviour: Temporary transport failures retry twice.

nodes.name: Classify Transcript Model
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies the transcript data model response.
Input: Model RPC response.
Output: Complete model or sanitized failure.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Transcript Model Ready?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes complete transcript models.
Input: Classified model.
Output: Rendering or failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Set Transcript Runtime Configuration
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Injects non-secret Drive and verification configuration.
Input: Complete transcript model.
Output: Model plus folder and verification base URL.
Error behaviour: Blank folder safely uses My Drive root.

nodes.name: Populate Transcript Google Docs Template
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Renders the configured transcript model into the professional Google Docs HTML template.
Input: Complete academic model and runtime configuration.
Output: HTML, multipart body and artifact names.
Error behaviour: Deterministic rendering; Google API failures route downstream.

nodes.name: Create Transcript Google Doc
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Creates a populated Google Docs transcript in the configured Drive folder.
Input: Rendered multipart HTML document.
Output: Google Doc metadata.
Error behaviour: Retries temporary Google failures three times; permanent errors route to failure recording.

nodes.name: Classify Google Doc Creation
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies Google Doc creation.
Input: Drive API response.
Output: Google Doc ID or sanitized external failure.
Error behaviour: No retry; HTTP node owns retries.

nodes.name: Google Doc Created?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes successful Google Doc creation.
Input: Classified Doc response.
Output: PDF export or failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Export Transcript PDF
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Exports the populated Google Doc as PDF bytes.
Input: Google Doc ID.
Output: Binary property pdf.
Error behaviour: Retries temporary Google failures three times.

nodes.name: Validate Exported PDF
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Verifies that Google returned a PDF binary.
Input: Export response and prior context.
Output: PDF context plus binary.
Error behaviour: Missing binary routes to failure recording.

nodes.name: PDF Exported?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes valid PDF binaries.
Input: Validated PDF.
Output: Hash/upload or failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Compute Transcript PDF SHA256
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Computes the PDF SHA-256 checksum.
Input: Binary property pdf.
Output: checksum_sha256 plus PDF binary.
Error behaviour: Hashing failure stops before document registration.

nodes.name: Upload Transcript PDF
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Uploads the exported PDF bytes to Google Drive.
Input: PDF binary and checksum context.
Output: Uploaded Drive PDF metadata.
Error behaviour: Retries temporary Google failures three times.

nodes.name: Classify PDF Upload
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies Drive PDF upload.
Input: Drive upload response.
Output: PDF file ID or sanitized failure.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: PDF Uploaded?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes stored PDF artifacts.
Input: Classified PDF upload.
Output: Metadata update or failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Finalize Transcript PDF Metadata
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Names the PDF and places it in the configured Drive folder.
Input: Uploaded PDF ID, filename and optional parent.
Output: Final Drive metadata and links.
Error behaviour: Retries temporary Google failures three times.

nodes.name: Build Transcript Artifact
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Builds the final document-registration payload.
Input: Final Drive metadata.
Output: Google Doc ID, PDF ID, URL and checksum.
Error behaviour: Metadata failure routes to request failure recording.

nodes.name: Transcript Artifact Ready?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes complete document artifacts.
Input: Artifact context.
Output: Database registration or failure branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_request:{ operation:'transcript.document.record', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, institution_id:$json.institution_id, campus_id:$json.campus_id, requester:{type:'system'}, submitted_at:new Date().toISOString(), source:{channel:'workflow05'}, payload:{ transcript_request_id:$json.request_data.transcript_request_id, google_doc_id:$json.google_doc_id, pdf_drive_file_id:$json.pdf_drive_file_id, pdf_file_url:$json.pdf_file_url, checksum_sha256:$json.checksum_sha256, file_name:$json.pdf_file_name } } } }}

nodes.name: Record Transcript Document RPC
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the Google Doc/PDF once and creates the transcript-ready outbox job.
Input: Complete artifact metadata.
Output: Transcript document, delivery and outbox IDs.
Error behaviour: Temporary transport failures retry twice; idempotency is enforced in PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Classify Document Registration
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Classifies idempotent transcript document registration.
Input: Record RPC response.
Output: Registered IDs or sanitized failure.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Transcript Document Recorded?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes registered transcript artifacts.
Input: Classified registration.
Output: Success or failure-recording branch.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.jsCode:
const x=$json;
const d=x.record_data||{};
return [{json:{
  success:true,
  operation:'transcript.delivery.complete',
  correlation_id:x.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key:x.idempotency_key,
  data:{
    transcript_request_id:d.transcript_request_id||x.request_data.transcript_request_id,
    reference_number:x.transcript_model.reference_number||x.request_data.reference_number,
    verification_code:x.transcript_model.verification_code||x.request_data.verification_code||null,
    transcript_document_id:d.transcript_document_id||null,
    google_doc_id:x.google_doc_id,
    google_doc_url:x.google_doc_url||null,
    pdf_drive_file_id:x.pdf_drive_file_id,
    pdf_file_url:x.pdf_file_url,
    checksum_sha256:x.checksum_sha256,
    delivery_record_id:d.delivery_record_id||null,
    outbox_id:d.outbox_id||null,
    status:d.status||'ready',
    delivery_status:'queued',
    document_reused:Boolean(d.already_recorded)
  },
  warnings:[]
}}];

nodes.name: Build Transcript Completion Response
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Builds the standard successful Workflow 05 response.
Input: Registered transcript artifact.
Output: Request/reference/Drive/delivery metadata.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Prepare Transcript Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes external/document failure context for durable recording.
Input: Any failed Google or document-registration branch.
Output: Sanitized failure and request ID.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_request:{ operation:'transcript.request.fail', correlation_id:$json.correlation_id, institution_id:$json.institution_id, campus_id:$json.campus_id, requester:{type:'system'}, submitted_at:new Date().toISOString(), source:{channel:'workflow05'}, payload:{ transcript_request_id:$json.transcript_request_id, error_code:$json.failure_error.code, error_message:$json.failure_error.message, stage:$json.failure_error.stage } } } }}

nodes.name: Record Transcript Failure RPC
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Best-effort records the failed transcript request and audit evidence.
Input: Normalized failure with request ID.
Output: Failure-recording RPC response.
Error behaviour: Recording failure never replaces the primary sanitized error.

nodes.name: Build Transcript Failure Response
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Builds the standard sanitized Workflow 05 failure response.
Input: Primary failure plus best-effort recording result.
Output: Standard error JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

nodes.name: Respond Transcript External Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Returns a retry-aware external-service failure.
Input: Standard failure response.
Output: HTTP 502 JSON.
Error behaviour: No retry.

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const c=$('Populate Transcript Google Docs Template').item.json; const esc=String(c.google_doc_file_name||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'"); const since=new Date(new Date(c.submitted_at).getTime()-300000).toISOString(); const q=`name = '${esc}' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.document' and trashed = false and createdTime >= '${since}'`; return 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?spaces=drive&pageSize=10&orderBy=createdTime%20desc&fields=' + encodeURIComponent('files(id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,createdTime)') + '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(q); })() }}

nodes.name: Resolve Created Google Doc
nodes.notes: Resolves the Google Doc by exact deterministic filename and current request time when the upload endpoint returns an empty n8n item.

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const c=$('Compute Transcript PDF SHA256').item.json; const since=new Date(new Date(c.submitted_at).getTime()-300000).toISOString(); const q=`mimeType = 'application/pdf' and trashed = false and createdTime >= '${since}'`; return 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?spaces=drive&pageSize=10&orderBy=createdTime%20desc&fields=' + encodeURIComponent('files(id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,webContentLink,createdTime)') + '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(q); })() }}

nodes.name: Resolve Uploaded Transcript PDF
nodes.notes: Resolves the newest PDF created by the current request when the Drive media upload endpoint returns an empty n8n item. Controlled-pilot fallback.
